english.legislation: Contrary to section 61(5) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
vehicle operator / owner of a ship / aircraft / railway vehicle
upon which goods are shipped / carried
as stores for use on a voyage OR
as stores for use on a flight OR
as stores for use on a journey
to an eventual destination outside the UK OR
for use in port without payment of duty
without the authority of the proper officer
are landed / unloaded at a place in the UK

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 61(5)(a) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 provides that the goods shall be liable to be forfeited.
(ii) For offences committed on or before 30th December 2020 see offence wording document H10693 (CJS code CE79269).
